name: Claim denied despite approved authorization
member_inquiry: My MRI claim was denied because insurance says there was no authorization, but my doctor's office says it was approved.
expected_evidence: Coverage is active on the service date.
MRI is covered and requires prior authorization.
The claim was denied for AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND.
An APPROVED authorization covers the service date.
The claim location is L7102 while the authorization location is L7101.
Both locations belong to ABC Imaging and are in network.

name: Authorization actually missing
member_inquiry: My MRI claim was denied because authorization wasn't found.
expected_evidence: Coverage is active on the service date.
MRI is covered and requires prior authorization.
The claim was denied for AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND.
No authorization exists for this member, service, and service date.

name: Coverage showing inactive
member_inquiry: My doctor's office says my insurance is inactive, but I enrolled months ago.
expected_evidence: The servicing coverage status is INACTIVE.
Enrollment status is ACTIVE with an effective date of 2026-02-01.
There is no coverage termination date.
The eligibility record was last synchronized before enrollment became effective.

name: Payer system failure and recovery
member_inquiry: My claim was denied, but the authorization system isn't responding.
expected_evidence: Coverage is active on the service date.
MRI is covered and requires prior authorization.
The claim was denied for AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND and has no authorization reference.
An APPROVED authorization matches the member, service, provider, location, and service date.
The authorization is discoverable through alternate member, service, and date lookup.
